run_agent_remote: run the agent_remote CLI to connect a custom agent to a remote SC2 game instance
host_human_game: host a StarCraft II game as a human player with a remote agent connecting
configure_agent_race: configure the agent race and name when launching a remote SC2 agent
set_observation_resolution: set feature screen and minimap resolution for agent observations in SC2
render_sc2_game: render the SC2 game with pygame or step through observations without rendering
